quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsui Mining & Smelting annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 (year ended March 31, 2026) segment results: Functional Materials sales rose 33.4% and segment ordinary profit 65.0%, on higher copper foil volumes plus sales-price revisions reflecting demand trends and an optimised sales mix. Carrier-attached ultra-thin copper foil volumes rose on solid demand for semiconductor package substrates and smartphone motherboards; electrodeposited copper foil for printed wiring boards, including high-frequency board foil, rose on solid demand for multilayer boards for communications infrastructure, mainly AI servers. Copper foil revenue was JPY 134,982 million against JPY 93,211 million a year earlier. Metals rose on higher zinc and other non-ferrous prices and inventory gains despite worse overseas ore terms; Automotive Parts fell after all shares of Mitsui Kinzoku ACT (automotive door locks) were transferred on November 4, 2025, so only April-September 2025 is consolidated. No single customer accounted for 10% or more of net sales.
quarterly_data.figure: Copper foil revenue JPY 134,982 million (FY2025: JPY 93,211 million); copper foil production 21 thousand t (quarters 4 / 6 / 5 / 5); segment sales (100 million yen): Functional Materials 3,284 (+33.4%, ordinary profit 665, +65.0%), Metals 3,766 (+15.9%, ordinary profit 750, +68.7%), Automotive Parts 512 (down 46.6%), Other 1,364

quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsui Mining & Smelting annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Other Functional Materials products in FY2026: metal powders for electronic materials rose on solid multilayer ceramic capacitor (MLCC) demand in Japan and China; protective film materials for semiconductor equipment rose on solid demand for deposition and sintering components as semiconductors become denser; high-purity tantalum oxide fell on weak demand for its main use, smartphone SAW filters; display sputtering targets fell in volume as overseas panel makers shift to local procurement, though higher indium prices lifted selling prices; two-wheeler exhaust catalysts rose on India and China demand while four-wheeler catalysts fell on weak US and Indonesia demand. Sales by customer location: Japan JPY 429,086 million, China JPY 99,750 million, India JPY 71,118 million, other Asia JPY 98,743 million, North America JPY 25,952 million.

quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsui Mining & Smelting annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: During FY2026 the company expanded its production system for electrodeposited copper foil for high-frequency boards, where demand from high-performance communications infrastructure equipment is expected to grow, and decided on further staged capacity additions from fiscal 2026 (the company's fiscal year ending March 2027) onward. It also decided to expand atomized copper powder capacity to meet growing MLCC demand. Management states the Functional Materials business will keep investing in AI infrastructure and advanced semiconductor fields, where large growth is expected.

quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsui Mining & Smelting annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D in FY2026: Functional Materials focuses on materials for advanced semiconductors and information and communications - high-temperature technology for MicroThin carrier-attached ultra-thin copper foil, stronger supply capability for VSP high-frequency board copper foil and FaradFlex thin embedded-capacitor material, and commercialisation of negative thermal expansion material; it partnered with University of Tokyo start-up Gaianixx and set up the Kyushu Advanced Materials Development Center in April 2026. HRDP, a carrier for next-generation semiconductor chip mounting, moved to the Functional Materials business in October 2025. The company started building an initial mass-production plant for A-SOLiD solid electrolyte for all-solid-state batteries, decided to install mass-production trial equipment for functional porous materials, and is strengthening customer relationships for power-semiconductor bonding materials.
